A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-20, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#538). Pilot (RULES 16); larger tiers after the
gate and the owner. Six arms, 18 starts each (108 games), all classes. The issue's four arms plus hunt-nofight and
combined-nofight (the same with caution_winning_fight 0; it ships 1, and decides town attacks too).
Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; ctl plays as the build's shipped settings;
every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped (stalls, timeouts and crashes kept apart); frozen-turn bursts
classified.
Report per arm and per class: deaths and causes, CL at death, final and maximum level, deepest level; paired
rescued and newly killed against ctl (exact McNemar), identical plays; the shopping loop per game (town <-> DL1
trips, turns in town, transactions from town-transactions.jsonl, trips that buy nothing new); town hunt kills and
town attack notes with winning_fight accepting or refusing; deaths in town. Descriptive (RULES 14).
experiment.question: Do the opt-in ranged reserve and the advantage-based town hunt reduce the town <-> DL1 shopping loop (borg-reborn-rs #604, #385's earlier pilot) without new deaths, and does caution_winning_fight (which also decides town attacks, shipped 1) change what the town hunt does?
